I hope you can draw my character holding a game controller and playing video games in your art style!

Hello! I would like to commission art from you! I would like to get my OC drawn as a cop!

References:
1. My OC
2. Pose/outfit/background reference

I would like my OC (reference 1) to be drawn in the same pose and outfit as in reference 2. I like the background in reference 2, but if you want to change it you can! I would like my OC to look confident and smug in the art.

Important notes about my OC: She is a dog spirit. She has white diamond-shaped pupils. She does not need the mask on the side of her head in this art. She does not need the big ribbon or the bell at the bottom of her hair in this art. Any other changes are up to you.

Thank you!
